Blake Chang Promotional Headshot

A close-up portrait features Taiwanese actor Blake Chang smiling warmly against a dark, neutral background. His neatly styled black hair frames his face, drawing attention to his bright eyes and clear complexion. The circular crop centers on his head and shoulders, creating an intimate and engaging promotional image.

This headshot is used in promotional materials for the 2021 Taiwanese BL drama Innocent (VO: 無邪, Wu xié). The series, produced by Soul’Chill and aired on YouTube and GagaOOlala, follows Yu Shi’s struggle with dissociative identity disorder and his romance with Wu Zheng, portrayed by Blake Chang.
